title: Fullscreen Ads After Decompression
text: I recently found a need for something to unzip RAR and 7z files on my iPad.  I was recommended this app, and it works perfectly.  However, it has started displaying fullscreen ads after I decompress a file.  I don't really like that, but the real irony here is that the creators expect people to linger after decompressing.  Pretty non-intrusive, honestly.  I hope it stays that way.
